DeterminationBasis: T08-004 establishes unresolved determination handling and preservation of NOT_ESTABLISHED where required determination evidence is absent, conflicting or ambiguous. However, no existing T08 test establishes the separate semantics of INVALID or directly falsifies conflation of INVALID with NOT_ESTABLISHED. The requirement therefore remains a distinct determination-state separation gap requiring an explicit INVALID semantics test.

T08-004 preserves NOT_ESTABLISHED as an explicit unresolved determination state when applicable determination evidence is absent, conflicting or ambiguous. T08-010 independently requires DENY to rest on an established prohibition within the declared governance scope and explicitly prevents unresolved uncertainty or absence of permission from being represented as DENY. Together these tests establish the required distinction between NOT_ESTABLISHED and DENY.
